name: Docker & Virtualisation
description: Docker CE et gestionnaire de machines virtuelles KVM/QEMU

external.name: KVM/libvirt (activation + groupes)
external.description: Active le daemon libvirt, configure le socket de groupe et ajoute l'utilisateur aux groupes necessaires
external.cmd: sudo bash -c 'systemctl enable --now libvirtd && sed -i "s/^#unix_sock_group/unix_sock_group/" /etc/libvirt/libvirtd.conf && sed -i "s/^#unix_sock_rw_perms/unix_sock_rw_perms/" /etc/libvirt/libvirtd.conf && systemctl restart libvirtd && usermod -aG libvirt $SUDO_USER && usermod -aG kvm $SUDO_USER'

external.name: Docker CE
external.description: Moteur de conteneurs Docker (depot officiel docker.com)
external.cmd: sudo bash -c 'install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && . /etc/os-release && CODENAME=${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME} && echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu ${CODENAME} stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && apt update && apt install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin && usermod -aG docker $SUDO_USER'
